exclusiveFeatures.text: Expanded Ruud Shop: new progression items and materials available for Ruud.
High Bosses reward 4 items per kill (excluding Ruud and WCoins).
Triple-Boss Invasions: each boss wave spawns 3 bosses.
Four new Essences: Ruud, PvP, Boss and GR — used to craft special and high-tier items.
Ruud Sets Bonus: +5% Damage Decrease and +7% Max HP when full set is equipped.
Custom EXP Buff Items: Up to 130% Normal EXP achievable (excluding VIP and Season Pass bonuses).
Trader Crafting: craft powerful items using boss drops, Ruud, and GR materials.
Custom Jewels: 8 unique jewels with upgrade paths and special effects.
Custom Socket System with improved socket set bonus scaling.
Hotspots: every map has at least 3 high-density farming areas.
Global Attack Speed cap increased to 1150 for all classes.
Errtel Radiance rebalanced: cooldowns aligned across all radiance options.

jwlExplanations.name: Jewel of Ascension
jwlExplanations.description: It is a special jewel that can be used to upgrade an item to the next level up to +12.
info: Upgrades the item up to +12 and has 100% success rate.
Can be used on most of the items, including weapons, armors, wings, pendants, rings and pentagrams.
Upgrading an item with a Jewel of Ascension will not change its excellent options or ancient options.
The item must be at least +9 to be upgraded with a Jewel of Ascension.

jwlExplanations.name: Jewel of Supreme Ascension
info: Usable on Weapons, Armors, Shields, Wings, Pentagrams, Rings and Necklaces.
Cannot be used on items below +13.
Success Rate: 100%

jwlExplanations.name: Jewel of Final Ascension
info: Usable on Weapons, Armors, Shields, Wings, Pentagrams, Rings and Necklaces.
Cannot be used on items below +14.
Success Rate: 100%

jwlExplanations.name: Jewel of Accessory Ascension
jwlExplanations.description: Increases the level of Rings, Pendants and Necklaces from +0 up to +9.
info: Usable only on jewelry items.
On failure, item level is decreased by 1.
Success Rate: 85%

jwlExplanations.name: Jewel of Augmentation
jwlExplanations.description: Adds one random Excellent option to jewelry items.
info: Usable only on Pendants, Necklaces and Rings.
Can be applied multiple times to accumulate Excellent options.
Requires an Excellent item with at least 1 Excellent option.
Success Rate: 100%

jwlExplanations.name: Jewel of Refinement
jwlExplanations.description: Upgrades a Ring or Pendant into a stronger type.
info: Item must be +15 and have at least 4 Excellent options.
Resulting item will be +0 with 2 random Excellent options.
Rings and Pendants are converted to higher tier variants.
Success Rate: 70%
To create Socket Necklaces, use NPC Trader recipes.

jwlExplanations.name: Jewel of Ancient Perfection
jwlExplanations.description: Adds one random Excellent option to Ancient Set items.
info: Can be used on Ancient +15 items.
Works on Legendary Sets as well.
Can be applied multiple times to accumulate Excellent options.
If item already has 5 Excellent options, they will be rerolled.
Success Rate: 100%

jwlExplanations.name: Jewel of Socket Ascension
jwlExplanations.description: Upgrades an Imperial item into a similar Socket item with 5 sockets.
info: Resulting item will be a Socket version with 5 sockets.
If you are Crusader class, Templar Set will be created.
Requires an Ancient + Excellent Imperial item.
Item must be +13 or higher with at least 3 Excellent options.
Success Rate: 100%
